title: Squat: three rewards, one skill
tagline: Shown one phone video of two squats, three policies trained with different rewards all complete it (5/5 stages, no falls), though their V-JEPA 2 similarity to the clip ranges from 0.53 to 0.71.

story.shown: A 10-second phone video of one person doing two squats. SAM 3.1 isolates the person, MediaPipe lifts their pose to 3D, and inverse kinematics rebuilds it on the Unitree G1's proportions: the reference on the right of the first video.
story.learned: Three control policies, trained with PPO in mjlab for 2,000 iterations each. Each drives a physically simulated G1 with its own reward: copying joint angles (tracking), joint angles plus Meta's V-JEPA 2 video model (hybrid), or mostly V-JEPA 2 alone (latent).
story.how: A stage checker reads only the robot's own body: stand, squat, stand, squat, stand. All three finish every stage without falling. V-JEPA 2 scores how much each rollout looks like the video: each is closer to the clip than any other motion in the bank (best other: 'bend' at 0.52 DTW), yet the latent policy scores lower than tracking. A lower similarity score was not a failure to squat.

grid_caption: Solid robot: the trained policy, physically simulated. Green ghost: the reference it was shown.
